system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Namaste, can you help me? Perform action: Sends OTP for CHC Farm Machinery rental authentication. Here are my details: my mobile_number is 9876529040, my aadhaar_number is 100020002029.

function.name: chc_generate_otp
function.description: Sends OTP for CHC Farm Machinery rental authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

function.name: chc_create_booking
function.description: Books farm machinery for a specific date and duration. Transitions booking_status to 'requested'. Machinery must be available and operational. Requires session_token. Does NOT guarantee confirmation until CHC confirms. Fails if machinery unavailable, overlapping booking exists, booking duration exceeds limits, or date is in the past.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for booking tools.

land_area_acres.description: Area to be serviced in acres. Optional.
